toolPolicy.Category match - Tooltip: Capability class to match (read, write, exec, network, sensitive). Use * for any.
toolPolicy.Decision desc: What to do when this rule matches
toolPolicy.Effect - Tooltip: Allow runs the tool, Deny blocks it, Ask requires an approval before the call may run.
toolPolicy.Match desc: Which tool calls this rule applies to
toolPolicy.Matching help desc: Patterns accept * (any), an exact value, or globs using * and ?. The highest-priority matching rule wins; at equal priority deny beats ask beats allow.
toolPolicy.Not enforced yet desc: Rules saved here are stored only. They are not yet applied to tool calls, so a Deny rule does not block anything today. Do not rely on this page as a security control until enforcement ships.
toolPolicy.Priority - Tooltip: Higher priority rules win. By convention deny rules use a higher priority than allow rules.
toolPolicy.Resource - Tooltip: Pattern matched against the call's key argument. For shell/exec tools it is matched against each program the command runs (e.g. rm, sudo, git) — chaining, subshells and sudo/env wrappers are resolved, so a denied program can't be smuggled in. For other tools it matches a file path or URL. Use * for any.
toolPolicy.Scope desc: Which agent and subject this rule targets
toolPolicy.Store match - Tooltip: Store (agent) this rule applies to. Empty or * applies to all stores of the owner.
toolPolicy.Subject match - Tooltip: Subject/role the rule targets. Use * for any.
toolPolicy.Tool - Tooltip: Tool name to match, e.g. shell or office_*. Use * for any.
